context:
Goal: q_max keeps each color and size value in one place.
Problem (goal): the same values repeat in three places in q_max's main style file, under two name sets (156 names starting aq, 233 starting f2), and whether to merge the name sets is yours to say.
Based on (read): the shared layout decision for every repo with screens puts design values in one tokens file, and the styles are built from it.
Departs from: main keeps the values in q_max's main style file — they move to one tokens file that builds the styles.
The lane works on its other two roll-out steps meanwhile.
holds: The q_max roll-out step that merges its design values.

options.gain: One place to change a value; nothing on screen moves; a small change.
options.how: Values move to the tokens file and the styles are built from it; every name stays.
options.label: One file, keep both name sets
options.lose: Two name sets stay, one pointing at the other.

options.gain: One name set, simpler to read.
options.how: Same as a, plus every f2 name is renamed to its aq name across about 90 files.
options.label: One file, and one name set
options.lose: A much larger change touching every screen, so more to review and more risk.

ref: step r2 (q_max merges its three layers of design values into one)
reply: Withdrawn: one tokens file is already the shared rule, and keeping both name sets changes nothing on screen and can be undone, so the lane takes a without asking.
title: q_max: move its design values into one file, and keep or merge its two name sets?
why: It gives one place for each value now with no screen change; the rename can follow later if the two names start to hurt.
